name: GNX Harness Type Global Cell Patch
_about: Custom types P3: loads on map harness_t only and patches the mon_placements of harness_type_gcell's cell (h_type 9210) with newt. In a menu load this patch runs in the deferred load, after newt exists, and resolves the boot cell's pending name. Its folder sorts after harness_type_gcell, so on travel the cell exists before the patch. Not for players.
